title: 4-Tap FIR Filter
constraints: Signed 8-bit samples. Coefficients (1, 3, 3, 1): `y[n] = x[n] + 3·x[n−1] + 3·x[n−2] + x[n−3]`, a 12-bit signed result.
On a rising edge with `valid`, the sample is shifted in and `dout` is registered with the result that **includes** the new sample. Without `valid` nothing changes.
Synchronous reset clears the delay line and `dout`. Must be synthesizable. Multiplying by 3 is `(x << 1) + x`, and no multiplier is needed.
hints: Keep the three previous samples in registers, and compute the sum from `din` and those registers.
Sign-extend every term to 12 bits before adding.
The (1, 3, 3, 1) kernel is a binomial low-pass filter: a cheap smoothing filter.
